title: Intro to Web Development Workshop
summary: Build and publish your first web page in two hours. No experience needed.
description: A hands-on workshop for complete beginners. You will learn the basics of HTML and CSS, build a simple personal page and publish it. Bring a laptop; mentors will help you set up.

title: Pitch Clinic: Tell Your Story in 3 Minutes
summary: Practise your pitch and get feedback from founders before the pitch competition.
description: Bring a three-minute pitch for any idea. Each participant pitches and receives structured feedback from founders and peers. Ideal preparation for the Student Ventures Pitch Competition.

title: Paper Reading Group: Machine Learning for Health
summary: Discuss a recent paper on machine learning for diagnosing illness in low-resource settings.
description: We read and discuss one paper in depth. A facilitator introduces the methods and we discuss strengths, limitations and ethical questions. The paper is shared a week in advance.

title: CV & Cover Letter Clinic
summary: Get one-on-one feedback on your CV before internship deadlines.
description: Volunteers from industry and the Career Readiness Network review CVs and cover letters one-on-one. Bring a printed or digital copy. Sessions are 15 minutes each on a first-come basis.

title: Campus Tree Planting Morning
summary: Help plant 100 native trees along the campus walkways.
description: Join volunteers to plant native trees along campus walkways. Gloves, tools and refreshments are provided. Wear comfortable clothes and bring a water bottle.

title: Public Debate: Should Universities Ban Smartphones in Class?
summary: A lively public debate followed by an audience vote.
description: Two teams from the Hillside Debate Union argue this motion in British Parliamentary style. The audience votes before and after the debate to see whose arguments changed minds.

title: Women in Tech Career Panel
summary: Alumni working in software, data and engineering share their career journeys.
description: A panel of alumni discuss their paths into technology careers, how they navigated challenges and what they wish they had known as students. Q&A and informal networking follow.

title: Personal Finance 101: Budgeting as a Student
summary: Practical budgeting, saving and mobile-money tips for students.
description: Learn how to build a simple monthly budget, avoid common money mistakes and start saving. Includes a hands-on budgeting exercise with a template you can keep.

title: Volunteer Orientation: Reading Clubs
summary: Required orientation for new reading club volunteers.
description: Learn how our reading clubs work, safeguarding basics and practical activities for young readers. Required before your first Saturday placement.

title: UX Critique Night
summary: Bring a design in progress and get constructive feedback from peers.
description: Each participant shares a design — an app screen, poster or website — and receives structured feedback. A short talk on giving useful critique opens the session.

title: Robot Build Day
summary: Open lab day to start building for the Regional Student Robotics Challenge.
description: Teams and newcomers work in the fabrication lab with guidance from experienced members. Learn basic soldering, motor control and sensor wiring.

title: Managing Exam Stress Workshop
summary: Practical techniques for focus, sleep and stress management before exams.
description: A peer-led workshop with simple breathing techniques, study planning tips and information about campus support services.

title: Inter-Year Football Tournament
summary: Year groups compete in a friendly tournament. Spectators welcome.
description: Teams from each year group play short matches in a round-robin format, followed by a final. Come to play or cheer.

title: Film Screening & Discussion: African Cinema Classics
summary: Watch a classic of African cinema and join a facilitated discussion.
description: An evening screening of a celebrated African film followed by a discussion of its themes and history. Snacks provided.

title: Podcast Production Training
summary: Learn to record and edit audio for the campus podcast.
description: Hands-on training with microphones, recording software and basic editing. Ideal for anyone interested in the Student Podcast Producer role.

title: Talk: Data and the Future of Public Health
summary: A public health researcher discusses how data is changing disease prevention.
description: Our guest speaker discusses how data collection and analysis are used to plan health services, with examples from West Africa. Q&A follows the talk.

title: Build for Campus Hackathon — Kickoff
summary: Opening session: team formation, problem briefs and mentor introductions.
description: The official kickoff of the Build for Campus Hackathon. Hear the problem briefs, meet mentors and finalise your team. Building starts immediately after.

title: Founder Fireside Chat
summary: An informal conversation with a founder about building a company in Ghana.
description: A founder shares honest lessons about starting and growing a company: finding customers, hiring and handling setbacks. Audience questions are encouraged.

title: Sunrise Fitness Session
summary: A 45-minute group workout for all fitness levels.
description: Start the day with a guided group workout combining cardio, stretching and bodyweight exercises. Suitable for beginners.

title: Undergraduate Research Showcase
summary: Students present posters and short talks on their research projects.
description: The annual showcase features posters and lightning talks from student researchers across disciplines. Visitors can vote for the people's choice award.

title: Cultural Night Showcase
summary: An evening of music, dance, poetry and fashion from across the continent.
description: Performers from across the student body share music, dance, spoken word and fashion. The biggest arts event of the semester.

title: Mock Interview Evening
summary: Practise behavioural and technical interviews with volunteers from industry.
description: Book a 30-minute mock interview slot. Interviewers provide written feedback on your answers, communication and preparation.

title: Git & GitHub for Group Projects
summary: Learn branching, pull requests and resolving merge conflicts.
description: A practical session on using Git and GitHub for team projects: branching, pull requests, code review and resolving merge conflicts.

title: Open Mic Poetry Night
summary: Share a poem, song or story at an informal open mic.
description: Sign up on the night to perform for up to five minutes. All languages and styles welcome.

title: Coastal Clean-up Trip
summary: Day trip to support a coastal clean-up with a partner organisation.
description: Travel by bus to join a coastal clean-up. Lunch and transport provided. Limited seats.
